question: In which of the following years was the National Anthem adopted in its Hindi version by the Constituent Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Anthem of India, **Jana Gana Mana**, was adopted in its Hindi version by the Constituent Assembly on **24th January 1950**__.
 
• The anthem was originally composed in Bengali by **Rabindranath Tagore** in 1911.
 
• It was translated into Hindi and the version was adopted to instill a sense of national
